title: WordPress counter dependencies recount after successful Sync mutations
steps: Merge relationship, post and comment mutations through both table and row paths; preserve kept conflicts and absent targets.
Run the existing shared Joomla merge fixture to guard adapter isolation.
expect: Relationship add/delete and post status/type changes queue native taxonomy recounts.
Comment add/delete/approval changes queue native post comment recounts.
Kept column conflicts queue nothing; explicit live choices queue their dependencies.
Missing final targets are omitted and Joomla rebuild behavior stays unchanged.
